differences.title: 1. RUNTIME COMPATIBILITY
differences.leftDesc: Hono runs natively on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, and Node.js, offering exceptional portability across diverse JavaScript runtimes and edge environments.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia is built on Bun, leveraging its speed and advanced features, but is primarily designed for Node.js environments, offering deep integration with Bun's ecosystem.

differences.title: 2. TYPE SAFETY
differences.leftDesc: Hono provides optional TypeScript support, allowing developers to leverage types but not enforcing them strictly, facilitating quicker adoption for JavaScript developers.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia enforces strict TypeScript from the ground up, ensuring compile-time type checking for routes, context, and plugins for robust application safety.

differences.title: 3. PLUGIN SYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Hono's plugin system is straightforward, allowing custom middleware and integrations. It emphasizes ease of use and minimal overhead for common tasks.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia features a powerful, context-aware plugin architecture that deeply integrates with its type system, enabling complex state management and middleware composition.

differences.title: 4. PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Hono is designed for extreme performance with minimal abstractions, making it incredibly fast and resource-efficient, especially on edge runtimes with limited resources.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia harnesses Bun's JIT compiler and event loop for exceptional raw speed, offering competitive performance with a focus on developer experience.

differences.title: 5. CONTEXT MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Hono offers a simple context object for request and response management. It's functional and efficient, suitable for most common web application needs.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia provides a rich, typed context that can be extended with plugins, enabling sophisticated data sharing and state management across requests.

differences.title: 6. ROUTING
differences.leftDesc: Hono includes a performant router with standard features like parameter extraction and nesting, providing a reliable foundation for API development.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia's router is tightly integrated with its type system, ensuring that route parameters and context are statically typed, reducing runtime errors.

differences.title: 7. DEVELOPMENT EXPERIENCE
differences.leftDesc: Hono prioritizes a minimalist API and ease of use, making it quick to learn and implement, especially for developers coming from vanilla JS or simpler frameworks.
differences.rightDesc: Elysia offers an exceptional developer experience through its strong typing, intuitive API design, and seamless integration with the Bun ecosystem.
